title_en: Notice Regarding Basic Policy on Treasury Stock Holdings and Cancellation
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Fukuvi Chemical Industry adopted a basic policy governing treasury stock management. The policy establishes a holding limit of 10% of total outstanding shares, with mandatory cancellation of any excess holdings within the fiscal year in which they occur. The board also undertakes to review treasury stock holdings and their purposes on a regular basis.

The company holds treasury stock for potential use in future capital-efficient actions, including M&A and capital alliances, as well as equity incentive programs for executives and employees. As of October 31, 2026, the company held 1,477,783 treasury shares, representing 7.14% of 20,688,425 total outstanding shares, leaving room under the new 10% threshold to maintain strategic flexibility without requiring immediate cancellation.
